categories.category: Site host — IT parks / Tech SEZs
categories.playbook: Approach Estate / Facilities Manager -> Submit techno-commercial proposal (load, footprint, employee EV survey, revenue share) -> Pilot 2-4 bays on visitor parking -> 60-day fitout (HT tap-in via park substation) -> Phase-2 scale-up to employee parking and dedicated cab bays
categories.scoring: IT parks rank highest of all city site classes on captive demand: 8-12 hr predictable dwell time, 60-80 % four-wheeler EV mix among employees by FY27, and on-campus HT power means HT sanction is a tenant-level paperwork step, not a 6-month TANGEDCO upgrade.
